items.name: Time Trials
items.description: A set of timed vehicle and stunt-plane courses in GTA V, an optional extra not required for 100% completion; press coverage expects time trials to return in GTA 6.

sources.title: Stunt Plane Time Trials - GTA 5 Hobbies & Pastimes Guide

items.name: Street Races
items.description: Five night-time street races in GTA V, each unlocking the next, with a medal in every race needed for 100% completion. Street racing is confirmed for GTA 6, so a similar race set is expected.

sources.title: GTA 6: Everything we know so far

items.name: Off-Road Races
items.description: Six off-road races for trucks and bikes in GTA V, with a top-three finish in each needed for 100% completion. Off-road racing is confirmed for GTA 6, so a similar race set is expected.

sources.title: GTA 6: Everything we know so far

items.name: Sea Races
items.description: Four races on Seashark jet skis in GTA V, with a top-three finish in each needed for 100% completion. Press coverage expects sea races to return in GTA 6.
